# Thunderbird Development Dashboard stuck quit and restart

`node tb.mjs desktop --comm=[local path]` printing `Thunderbird Development Dashboard started.` is insufficient: verify a backend process and inspect UI/logs. This restart failed because the prepared app bundle lacked `Contents/Resources/process-runtime/version.json`. [Task 2]

Scope: general.
